summary: Tested the 'abbinamenti' (food pairing) field on backend and frontend. Backend: new test_abbinamenti_iter12.py, 15/15 passing. Covered: POST trims spaces, null becomes '', default '', max 1000 (1001 returns 422); PUT persists; GET returns the value; q=<term only in abbinamenti> returns [] (excluded from search); /api/public/carta includes abbinamenti without prezzo_acquisto/fornitore; CSV/XLSX export and template have the 'Abbinamenti' column; XLSX/CSV import recognises 'Abbinamenti', 'Food pairing' and 'Abbinamento'; mode=update overwrites it, and an update from a file without the column does not wipe it; backup contains the field; a backup->restore round-trip keeps it. Full regression run in sequence (-n 0): 112/112 after updating one outdated assertion. Frontend: textarea wine-form-abbinamenti-input sits under the Note field and has maxLength 1000. Create and edit save the value and it comes back when the form is reopened. detail-abbinamenti shows it. /carta shows carta-item-abbinamenti-{id} only for the wine that has a value (0 for the one without). /carta-digitale without login: public-wine-abbinamenti shows for the wine with a value and is absent for the one without. The public client-side search does not match on abbinamenti. Mobile 390px: form and public sheet have no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390).

minor.issue: In build_xlsx the widths list has 18 entries but COLUMNS now has 19, so the new 'Abbinamenti' column (S) gets Excel's default narrow width. Add a width (e.g. 50) to the list.

action_items: Optional: add a column width for 'Abbinamenti' in the widths list in build_xlsx (server.py)
critical_code_review_comments: build_xlsx widths list is out of sync with COLUMNS (18 vs 19). It is index-based and easy to break; consider storing the width next to each COLUMNS entry.
